en-US.name: Archify (DesireCore diagrams)
en-US.summary: Create architecture, workflow, sequence and other native diagrams, explainers and stories. The 3.3.0-based drawing edition supports live preview, self-contained HTML and SVG export. Requires Node.js 18+ and a local Chromium-family browser; FFmpeg is needed for MP4 story export.

zh-CN.name: Archify（DesireCore 绘图版）
zh-CN.summary: 生成架构图、流程图、时序图等可交互图表，以及讲解页和故事。基于 3.3.0 的绘图版支持实时预览、单文件 HTML 和 SVG 导出。需 Node.js 18+ 和本地 Chromium 系浏览器；故事导出为 MP4 需 FFmpeg。

requirements.value: Node.js 18+ for the renderers, plus Chrome, Chromium or Microsoft Edge (or set ARCHIFY_CHROME) for browser verification and export. Optional MP4 story export needs a separately installed FFmpeg. The generated validators ship with the skill and require no npm install.

finalize/deliver run a bounded update check against the upstream release manifest on GitHub Pages, cached for about a day in the user cache directory (ARCHIFY_UPDATE_CHECK_DISABLED=1 turns it off). The notice relays an upstream-written summary as untrusted text; an unavailable check never blocks delivery. Install or update only when the user asks.

Proactive or always-on explainer modes are enabled only when the user explicitly accepts, by adding one line to the agent's global rules file (outside the workspace, such as ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md); the agent names the file and deleting the line turns the mode off. Never add or change that line without the user's consent.

The drawing edition installs native diagrams, explainers, stories, preview and export. Generated artifacts carry software notices. The installed scope excludes the standalone Code Analysis workbench and its vendor payload.
